page.title: Support
page.intro: Need help with Uha, found a bug, or have feedback? Email me directly. I read every support email myself.
page.include_intro: To help me reproduce the issue, include:
page.include_device: Your iPhone model, iOS version, and Uha version.
page.include_steps: What you did, what happened, and what you expected.
page.include_screenshots: Screenshots or a screen recording with private subscription details hidden.
page.include_purchase: For purchase or installation issues, say whether you use the App Store or TestFlight version.
page.beta_body: Unlimited is a one-time App Store purchase. Apple handles billing and refund requests. TestFlight purchases are free test transactions and do not carry over to the App Store version.
page.restore_body: In Uha, open Settings, then Unlimited, and choose Restore Purchases. Use the Apple Account you used for the purchase. This restores access to Unlimited, not your subscription data. If you still cannot access Unlimited, email me and include the error message.
page.export_body: Exporting CSV files and creating local backups are free. Importing CSV files, restoring backups, and creating iCloud backups require Unlimited. Importing or restoring replaces your current subscription data, so save a backup first.
page.data_body: Your subscription data is stored on your device. You create backups manually in your own iCloud account, and each new backup replaces the previous one. Backups do not automatically sync your devices. I cannot retrieve your subscription data through the public website or MCP server.
page.security_body: For a suspected security issue, include the affected URL or app area, steps to reproduce it, and its impact. Do not send passwords, payment details, or private subscription lists.
